verdict.rationale: Convex is itself a managed reactive database. Projects are provisioned with `npm create convex@latest` and run on a cloud dev deployment that holds tables with no setup ([convex-docs-38], [convex-docs-2], [convex-docs-13], [convex-docs-6]). Data is read and written through TypeScript queries and mutations that run in the database, which can be called from React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte and other client frameworks, from the CLI, or over HTTP endpoints, with ACID writes and real-time sync ([convex-docs-1], [convex-docs-39], [convex-docs-18], [convex-docs-31], [convex-docs-12], [convex-docs-21]); Convex engineers describe the query/mutation reactivity model on Hacker News ([convex-comm-2]). Missing for 10: explicit client SDK API documentation (hook/client method names), a documented server-side SDK for calling Convex from external backends beyond the HTTP API, and an independent hands-on provisioning walkthrough.
